rows.name: Microsoft Enterprise Library Semantic Logging Application Block
rows.reason: Semantic Logging routes EventSource to SQL/files. Observed .NET 4.5 package last updated 2014; sinks are separate. Exception capture/decomposition fit, maintenance and runtime compatibility remain uncertain.

rows.name: log4net
rows.reason: Provides SQL logging through AdoNetAppender, local rotating files through RollingFileAppender, and exception formatting, satisfying the application's SQL-plus-local diagnostic logging requirements.

rows.name: Serilog.Sinks.MSSqlServer only (WriteTo batch; no file/durable fallback)
rows.reason: The specified SQL-only configuration omits the required local log. Its publisher documents WriteTo batching and possible batch loss on connection failure; adding a file sink would change the supplied candidate.

rows.name: NLog with DatabaseTarget and a local File target
rows.reason: NLog documents SQL/file routing and exceptions. Select packages for actual .NET; configure schema/parameters/output and test local logs under application-SQL failure and logging-database outage. Python support unverified.

rows.name: Logseq
rows.reason: Logseq is a local notebook/outliner for notes and journals. It does not provide the requested C#/WPF diagnostic pipeline; local note storage does not establish SQL-plus-local logging.

rows.name: NLog with NLog.Database and a File target
rows.reason: NLog 5 needs NLog.Database, provider and extension registration for SQL exceptions alongside parallel files. Verify buffering/shutdown; database failure does not guarantee durable fallback. Native Python support unestablished.

rows.name: log4net
rows.reason: AdoNetAppender covers SQL and RollingFileAppender covers local logs; multiple appenders and direct exception-object logging are documented. Retain with both destinations configured and package compatibility checked.

rows.name: Apache log4net with AdoNetAppender and RollingFileAppender
rows.reason: .NET SQL/rotating-file exception logging needs schema/connections/parameters/separate file appender. Buffering requires delivery/exit evaluation. 2.0.15 is historical evidence, not old-version recommendation amid current advisory. Python integration unverified.

rows.name: Serilog.Sinks.MSSqlServer only (WriteTo batch; no file/durable fallback)
rows.reason: The batched SQL sink can lose events when SQL connectivity fails and, as supplied, has no local-file fallback, violating the critical local logging requirement.

rows.name: Apache log4net with AdoNetAppender and RollingFileAppender
rows.reason: .NET logging supports SQL inserts, rotating files, multiple appenders and exceptions. Requires ADO.NET provider/schema and matching package/runtime versions. Delivery is best effort; Python support unestablished.

rows.name: Logseq
rows.reason: Its documented purpose is knowledge management and note-taking; it supplies no verified C# exception-logging pipeline to SQL and local files.
